description: Use this when the user asks what Alicia or digitalgarden.si has written about a subject (for example Houdini, Three.js, WebGPU, glTF/USD, Gaussian splats, AI coding agents, or the garden itself). Ranks published notes by keyword match on title, topics, summary and full text, in English and Chinese, and returns short cards (no full text). Follow up with get_article to read one. Do not use it for general web search, news, or topics unrelated to Alicia's published notes. An empty articles array means no published note matches. Scores are relative to this query and catalog, not confidence percentages; check titles and read the full note before presenting a match as relevant. Every result includes canonicalUrl and author Alicia (Person @id https://digitalgarden.si/#alicia). Cite the canonical URL when quoting. digitalgarden.si is an interactive 3D garden, not a knowledge-base wiki.

language.description: Optional language filter: en for English, zh or zh-CN for Simplified Chinese (both mean the same). Omit to include both languages.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return, 1-20. Default 5.

query.description: Required search keywords in English or Chinese, e.g. "houdini gltf export". Plain words, not a question; 1-200 characters.

topic.description: Optional topic filter, ideally an exact topic name returned by list_topics. Partial matches of 3+ characters also match.

name: search_articles
title: Search garden articles
